title: PvP Tiers Pack
description: Perfect For Practicing / Teir Testing and much more
body:
# PvP Teirs Modpack

## Made by oof3559

### This is a PvP modpack I put together to match what’s allowed on McTiers. It’s mainly focused on getting better FPS, cleaner visuals, and some small PvP improvements without adding anything unfair.

### **This is NOT an official McTiers modpack.**

## What it does:

1. - Gives you way better performance (less lag, more FPS)
2. - Makes PvP feel smoother (better hit reg, clearer screen, less visual clutter)
3. - Adds useful info like armor durability, ping, totem count, etc.
4. - Improves visuals with things like fullbright, zoom, and dynamic lights
5. - Keeps everything within McTiers allowed mods (as much as possible)

###  I tried to include all the allowed mods and resource packs, but if something is missing or not allowed, let me know and I’ll fix it.

## Resource packs included:

1. - Low Fire
2. - Low Shield
3. - Small Totem Pop
